doc: BitNet b1.58 (BitNetForCausalLM; the bf16-master checkpoints, e.g. microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16): Llama's pre-norm decoder with a ReLU-squared gated MLP and two sub-layer norms — an RMSNorm over the attention output (the heads' concatenation, hidden wide) before o_proj and one over the gated product (intermediate wide) before down_proj (SUBLAYER_NORMS_V1). The released 1.58-bit checkpoint stores packed ternary weights (uint8, with a weight_scale) and quantises activations per token to int8: that is a quantised-storage format, not read here, so those tensors fail to bind by name. Features: ATTN_GQA_V1, ROPE_DEFAULT_V1, NORM_RMS_V1, SUBLAYER_NORMS_V1, MLP_DENSE_GATED_V1.
